responsibility: Provides the generic non-Linux ELF target configuration for Arm. It sets conservative default target options, defines the default startfile/endfile sequence and init/fini macro, prefers DWARF2 debugging, customizes aligned BSS/local object emission for named sections, and adjusts libgcc/libc link grouping to accommodate exception-unwind dependencies, serving as the fallback ELF environment for bare-metal or otherwise unknown Arm systems.
